title: Keurig Dr Pepper: The Capital Behind Your Daily Beverage of Choice
summary: KDP is behind some of America’s most recognizable beverage brands. As the company prepares for its next phase, Apollo is providing tailored capital to help enable its transformation.
body_markdown:
### Two Bespoke Solutions, Tailored to KDP’s Strategic Objectives


Apollo, working with KKR,[structured two complementary solutions](https://www.keurigdrpepper.com/kdp-discusses-strategy-leadership-and-financing-for-upcoming-transformational-transactions/) . Apollo led a $4 billion investment in a newly formed joint venture holding KDP’s single-serve coffee manufacturing assets, with KDP retaining majority ownership and full operational control. That gave the beverage provider access to cost-efficient capital tied to the cash flows from its K-Cup coffee business without consolidating debt on its balance sheet.


Apollo and KKR also led a convertible preferred equity investment to support the company's beverage business – offering fixed dividends along with the potential for additional upside if investors converted the preferred shares to common stock. Demand proved robust enough to increase the size of the facility to $4.5 billion from $3 billion. That strengthened KDP’s credit metrics while preserving the flexibility the company needed to complete the planned separation on its own timeline.


Together, the two investments provided KDP with sufficient capital to accelerate deleveraging from the JDE Peet's acquisition and advance toward the planned separation, targeted for early 2027, while positioning both companies to operate with strong, independent balance sheets from day one.
